001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.PumpFeaturesV2Response;
007
008import java.util.Arrays;
009import java.util.Set;
010
011/**
012 * The pump's Control-IQ feature bitmask: the value {@link PumpFeaturesV2Response} returns for
013 * {@link PumpFeaturesV2Response.SupportedFeatureIndex#CONTROL_IQ_FEATURES}, or 0 on firmware that
014 * does not support that index. It is fixed by the firmware, not by settings: 0 on t:slim X2 API 2.5
015 * and Mobi 7.6.0.3, 49 on t:slim X2 API 3.2/3.4, 3072 on Mobi 7.7.0.1 and 896 on Mobi 7.9.0.1 and
016 * 7.9.0.2. Across 81 records from 8 pumps it matched the live response in every session that
017 * captured both, and it changed only at the first boot after a firmware update.
018 *
019 * <p>Written at every boot, right after {@code ArmInit} and {@code VersionInfo} (on the X2, after
020 * opcode 312 as well), and in the block the pump writes after every {@link NewDayHistoryLog}
021 * ({@link VersionsAHistoryLog}, opcode 449, opcode 450, this record, {@link DailyStatusHistoryLog}):
022 * at midnight, after a boot on a new calendar day, after a log erase and after a date change.
023 * Older t:slim X2 firmware without PumpFeaturesV2 does not write it.
024 *
025 * <p>The class name is provisional: opcode 328 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
026 * app's history log list. Bytes 14-25 have been zero in every record and are exposed raw.
027 * See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/152.
028 */
029@HistoryLogProps(
030    opCode = 328,
031    displayName = "Control-IQ Features"
032)
033public class ControlIQFeaturesHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
034
035    private long controlIqFeaturesBitmask;
036    private byte[] unknownTail;
037
038    public ControlIQFeaturesHistoryLog() {}
039    public ControlIQFeaturesHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long controlIqFeaturesBitmask, byte[] unknownTail) {
040        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
041        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, controlIqFeaturesBitmask, unknownTail);
042        this.controlIqFeaturesBitmask = controlIqFeaturesBitmask;
043        this.unknownTail = Arrays.copyOf(unknownTail, 12);
044    }
045
046    public ControlIQFeaturesHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long controlIqFeaturesBitmask) {
047        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, controlIqFeaturesBitmask, new byte[12]);
048    }
049
050    public int typeId() {
051        return 328;
052    }
053
054    /**
055     * <table border="1">
056     * <caption>Parsed fields for ControlIQFeaturesHistoryLog:</caption>
057     * <tr><td><code>controlIqFeaturesBitmask</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
058     * <tr><td><code>unknownTail</code></td><td><code>Arrays.copyOfRange(raw, 14, 26)</code></td></tr>
059     * </table>
060     */
061    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
062        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
063        this.cargo = raw;
064        parseBase(raw);
065        this.controlIqFeaturesBitmask = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10);
066        this.unknownTail = Arrays.copyOfRange(raw, 14, 26);
067    }
068
069    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long controlIqFeaturesBitmask, byte[] unknownTail) {
070        Validate.isTrue(unknownTail.length == 12, "unknownTail must be 12 bytes");
071        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
072            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(328, 0),
073            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
074            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
075            Bytes.toUint32(controlIqFeaturesBitmask),
076            unknownTail));
077    }
078
079    /**
080     * Only the low 16 bits have ever been set: 0, 49 (bits 0, 4, 5), 3072 (bits 10, 11) or 896
081     * (bits 7, 8, 9) observed.
082     *
083     * @return the uint32 at offset 10, the PumpFeaturesV2 CONTROL_IQ_FEATURES bitmask
084     */
085    public long getControlIqFeaturesBitmask() {
086        return controlIqFeaturesBitmask;
087    }
088
089    /**
090     * The bits of {@link #getControlIqFeaturesBitmask()} that pumpX2 has names for. The names come
091     * from {@link PumpFeaturesV2Response.ControlIqFeatureType} and are not confirmed by this record;
092     * bits 4, 5, 7 and 10, which are set on some firmware, have no name and appear only in the raw
093     * bitmask.
094     *
095     * @return the named Control-IQ features in the bitmask
096     */
097    public Set<PumpFeaturesV2Response.ControlIqFeatureType> getControlIqFeatures() {
098        return PumpFeaturesV2Response.ControlIqFeatureType.fromBitmask(controlIqFeaturesBitmask);
099    }
100
101    /**
102     * Bytes 14-25, all zero in every observed record (81/81).
103     */
104    public byte[] getUnknownTail() {
105        return unknownTail;
106    }
107}
